WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    s.entrystat,
    AVG(se.ambictemp) as avg_temp,
    AVG(se.imgcount) as avg_imgcount
  FROM scanenvironment se
  JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = se.zoneref
  GROUP BY s.entrystat
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_imgcount) as overall_avg_imgcount
  FROM step1
)
SELECT 
  step1.entrystat,
  step1.avg_temp,
  step1.avg_imgcount,
  step1.avg_imgcount - step2.overall_avg_imgcount as difference
FROM step1
CROSS JOIN step2
WHERE step2.overall_avg_imgcount IS NOT NULL
